title: Let's jump in
body_text:
Before giving you further instructions, you will perform a first training task in order to discover the interface. This task will not count towards your score and remuneration, and the results will not be recorded. You will be presented with a series of 5 images of symbols of colors, and you will have to answer a question pertaining to each of the images. For this task and few other tasks of the Introduction, you will be informed if the decision was right or wrong after each decision.

As for every task later, the question will be the same for every image of the task. The question will usually change every new task, except for the tasks of the Discovery and Acclimatation sequences of the Introduction.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
